sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, travel to Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. This is a strong opportunity for the leaders, as Alsager sit bottom of the division with just 4 points and are in dire form with only one win in their last five matches. Sandbach's recent loss notwithstanding, they remain unbeaten at home this season and will be heavy favourites to maintain their title challenge.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host Dawley Town on Saturday, seeking to close the one-point gap at the top following their own recent loss. AFC Bridgnorth, third with 19 points, face Eccleshall (sixth, 18 points) in a direct mid-table clash. Wolverhampton Casuals, also on 19 points, visit Wednesfield Community in a lower-order fixture before facing Brereton Social in a midweek replay on Wednesday 7 October. Bilston Town (fifth, 17 points) travel to Foley Meir (14th, 11 points), while Barnton host Shawbury United in a battle between mid-table and struggling sides. New Mills visit Market Drayton Town in a contest between two teams seeking form. Cheadle Heath Nomads host Telford Town in a basement six-pointer, with both sides severely depleted on points. Crewe entertain Allscott Heath in a low-table affair. Brereton Social, occupying the relegation zone, face Widnes Town (bottom, 2 points) at home on Saturday—a critical fixture for Social's hopes of climbing clear of the drop zone.
